ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE ep
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile lucrate norma intreaga
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.ZileLucrate =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ep.TipNorma,1) = 1
            THEN

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    ) < 0
                    THEN 0

                    ELSE
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                END

            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile 1/2 norma
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.Zile12Norma =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ep.TipNorma,1) = 0.5
            THEN

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    ) < 0
                    THEN 0

                    ELSE
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                END

            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile program redus
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.ZileProgramRedus =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ep.TipNorma,1) = 0.75
            THEN

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    ) < 0
                    THEN 0

                    ELSE
                        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                END

            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Total zile lucrate
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.ZileLucrateTotal =

        ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrate,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.Zile12Norma,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZileProgramRedus,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZileInvoire,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZilePrezentaIncerta,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.ZileSomajTehnic,0)

        - ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS,0)

        - ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Ore lucrate
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.OreLucrate =

        (
            ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrate,0)

            + ISNULL(ep.Zile12Norma,0)

            + ISNULL(ep.ZileProgramRedus,0)

            + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)

            + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
        )

        * ISNULL(ep.TipNorma,1)

        * 8

        + ISNULL(ep.OreInvoire,0)

        + ISNULL(ep.OrePrezentaIncerta,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.StatusValidare =

        CASE
            WHEN
                (
                    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileInvoire,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZilePrezentaIncerta,0)
                ) > ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
            THEN 'EROARE'

            WHEN
                (
                    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileInvoire,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZilePrezentaIncerta,0)
                ) = ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
            THEN 'OK_COMPLET'

            ELSE 'OK'
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Mesaj validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.MesajValidare =

        CASE
            WHEN
                (
                    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS31,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileInvoire,0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZilePrezentaIncerta,0)
                ) > ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0)
            THEN 'Total zile depaseste zilele lucratoare.'

            ELSE NULL
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.LastModifiedBy = @UserId,

    ep.LastModifiedDate = GETDATE()

FROM app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep

WHERE ep.Id = @IdExceptiePrezenta
